# Material Symbols interaction icon (superseded candidate)

The filled rounded `front_hand` icon was the initial compact open-palm
candidate. The 2026-09-02 user-approved private Phase 1 runtime instead uses
the hash-locked donor `gui_uset` icon recorded in
`Phase1UiInteractionPresentationManifest.json`. This source remains only as an
audited, licensed fallback and is not the active player-prefab binding.

Source revision: `84ccef280841abfac506afc4ad4a2782f6d0a1d0`

Source: <https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/84ccef280841abfac506afc4ad4a2782f6d0a1d0/symbols/web/front_hand/materialsymbolsrounded/front_hand_24px.svg>

License: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE.txt`.

The source SVG is preserved unchanged. The inactive `hand.png` is a mechanical
64 x 64 white-on-transparent rasterization cropped to a compact HUD silhouette.

Runtime raster SHA-256:
`57c7d1e4d80478690e7a1292bcf87cccba020861100bf30b5643b44740fec98a`.
